description: Sources for 47 map images covering data/entities/maps.json, including 38 full-resolution screenshots from the official Dead by Daylight map gallery. The pre-existing hartshorne-mall.webp remains unchanged and is not included in this import manifest.
rights: Dead by Daylight game artwork belongs to Behaviour Interactive and its respective licensors; source URLs record provenance, not a new license grant.
processing: Official-site JPEG/PNG screenshots are converted to WebP at quality 95 with original dimensions preserved. Remaining third-party WebP files are copied unchanged; remaining wiki PNG sources use lossless WebP. See each image entry for conversion details.
